## Goal
Move workflow skill, config namespace, help metadata, language defaults, and AI agent override resolution into the workflow plugin.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R5, R9, AC4, AC6, AC12, AC14, and AC18 are covered.
- Workflow plugin config uses plugin.config.workflow for flowIntegration, languages, and agent overrides.
- Workflow plugin skill/help mention ideas and plugin-owned behavior, not removed subcommands.
- Workflow plugin AI calls use the public plugin agent API/context rather than core internal imports.

## Implementation Notes
Keep workflow-specific agent key interpretation inside the plugin. Core receives only generic agent execution requests.

## Test Strategy
Plugin repo tests cover config defaults/schema, agent override resolution, skill text expectations, and help metadata for command and subcommands.
